items.title: Eddie Dawson Interview, 1962-01-31
items.q: I played up there one night with Clayton, you know.

ctx.x: Uh-huh. Did they have any piano players, or were they mostly guitar players at those? Well, they had some piano players, too. They had some.

I met a fella up there for, uh, this old piano player, which used to play at them time. I can't think of his name now. But Clayton, know him good. He's blind. I happened to meet him. I played up there one night with Clayton, you know. And I saw him up there. What kind of piano player was he? Oh, just a little blues. Big old blues. Big old blues piano player. That's what I would call his play. Played like Sonny Swan or Kato or somebody like that on that auto? No, they had an old fake piano player. They had no idea…
